subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When the operator approves a lock, the system shall record the operator's capture line with the approval, or record the approval as lineless when none is given.
rationale: Read-to-rule's gate-time measurement continues for draft-born features, and a lineless gate never blocks (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-21)
fit_criterion: Fixture approvals given with a capture line store it verbatim — minutes spent, each feedback item marked in or outside §0 — and approvals given without one are recorded as lineless and still lock.
